name: Adopt personas to bypass safety guidelines
description: Users asked the assistant to adopt specific personas, such as unfiltered versions of AI, historical figures, or specialized experts, often with the intent to bypass safety guidelines or provide unrestricted responses. These requests frequently involved role-playing scenarios where the character would ignore ethical constraints to answer sensitive questions, provide illegal instructions, or treat fictional premises as absolute facts.
